messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]
- On 2025-12-29, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29-2]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-12-29, the ledger remains an Ember team service. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29-2]
- As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then, and the Ember team never held it. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04; recorded by handover/2025-06-20-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-28; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- For anything Ember-related, page Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
    earlier: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar. [decision; valid 2025-03-19 to 2026-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-3]
- The Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-2]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline lives with Team Cinder; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]
- As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
- As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
    earlier: The resizer lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- Effective 2025-12-05, Diego Alvarez joined the Ember team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-05]
- The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]
- As of the 2026-06-18 rotation, Diego holds the Ember team pager. [valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
    earlier: As of the 2026-05-18 rotation, Oskar holds the Ember team pager, having taken it over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to 2026-06-18; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]
    earlier: As of the 2026-03-31 rotation, Diego Alvarez holds the Ember team pager, having taken it over from Oskar. [valid 2026-03-31 to 2026-05-18; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2025-05-23 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-23]
- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer lives with Team Dune; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]

Question: Which team owned auth-gateway before Ember?

The question asks which team owned auth-gateway before Ember.

Looking at the ownership history:
- The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31]
- As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then.

So the ownership timeline: Ember (2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31), then Boreal (2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23), then Atlas (2025-12-23 to now).

Before Ember held it, what was it? The memory doesn't say who owned it before 2025-01-20. The earliest entry is Ember starting 2025-01-20. There's no entry saying who owned it before Ember.

Wait — the question might be interpreted as "which team owned auth-gateway before [it went to] Ember" — but memory doesn't contain that. Alternatively, "before Ember" could mean the team that owned it immediately prior to Ember's ownership period. The memory's earliest record is that Ember held it from 2025-01-20. There's no prior owner recorded.

Hmm, but maybe the question is asking the inverse: after Ember, who owned it? "Before Ember" — no, that's clear: before Ember's ownership. The memory doesn't state that. So the answer is "I don't know".

Actually, wait. Let me reconsider. Perhaps the question means: which team owned auth-gateway before Ember did — i.e., the predecessor. Memory says nothing about pre-2025-01-20 ownership. So "I don't know".

But maybe the intended reading: the question could be poorly worded and mean "which team owned auth-gateway before [the current owner]?" — the current owner is Atlas (as of 2025-12-23 to now, today 2026-06-30). Before Atlas was Boreal. But "before Ember" doesn't fit that reading.

Alternatively, "before Ember" could be a typo for "after Ember"? We shouldn't guess. The rules say answer only from memory; if not contained, reply "I don't know".

The ownership sequence in memory: Ember was the earliest recorded owner. Nothing before Ember. So I don't know.
